name: kind: Wellfound job page url
spec_quote: New: 'wellfound' when the url (lower-cased) contains "wellfound.com/jobs/" followed by digits (a job page such as https://wellfound.com/jobs/4964451-sap-ixp-intern-ai-product-management)

name: kind: www.wellfound.com job page url
spec_quote: with "wellfound.com" either at the start, after "/" or after "." (www.wellfound.com)

name: kind: Wellfound company page is not a job page
spec_quote: A Wellfound company page (wellfound.com/company/acme), a search page (wellfound.com/jobs?role=…) or another site → not 'wellfound'. Anything else → None (null).

name: kind: Wellfound search page is not a job page
spec_quote: A Wellfound company page (wellfound.com/company/acme), a search page (wellfound.com/jobs?role=…) or another site → not 'wellfound'. Anything else → None (null).

name: kind: LinkedIn view url unchanged
spec_quote: Existing values: ... 'linkedin' (matches "linkedin.com/jobs/view/" or "linkedin.com/comm/jobs/view/").

name: kind: other site with job-like path
spec_quote: A Wellfound company page (wellfound.com/company/acme), a search page (wellfound.com/jobs?role=…) or another site → not 'wellfound'. Anything else → None (null).

name: city_of: semicolon tail after city
spec_quote: New: a semicolon ends the city exactly like a comma: "New York; Recruiter recently active" → "new york"

name: city_of: semicolon between two place names keeps first
spec_quote: a semicolon ends the city exactly like a comma: ... "Syracuse; Fairborn" → "syracuse"

name: city_of: comma still ends the city
spec_quote: the text before the first comma is the city

name: city_of: '+ N' tail removed then comma split
spec_quote: Existing: "+ N" and everything after it is removed; ... the text before the first comma is the city

name: city_of: remote and following 'or' removed
spec_quote: the word "remote" (and a following "or") is removed; the text before the first comma is the city

name: title_companies: 'at' tail is the company

args.title: Data Scientist Intern - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey at McKinsey & Company

spec_quote: (a) after the LAST word "at" in the title: the rest of the title, when it starts with a capital letter and has at most 5 words: "Data Scientist Intern - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey at McKinsey & Company" → "McKinsey & Company".

name: title_companies: leading segment before ' - '

args.title: Lumharquin - AGI - AI Power Systems Intern

spec_quote: (b) the part before the first separator — " - " ... when that part has at most 4 words, starts with a capital letter and contains no job word. "Lumharquin - AGI - AI Power Systems Intern" → "Lumharquin"

name: title_companies: leading segment before ': '
spec_quote: (b) the part before the first separator — ... ": " (colon + space) ... — when that part has at most 4 words, starts with a capital letter and contains no job word.

name: title_companies: leading segment contains job words
spec_quote: (b) ... when that part has at most 4 words, starts with a capital letter and contains no job word. ... "Intern - Data Analytics" → nothing from (b).

name: title_companies: CamelCase first word
spec_quote: (c) the title's first word (a trailing , . : removed) when it is · CamelCase: a capital, lower-case letters, then another capital and at least one more letter ("BraRoskel", "PepsiCo", "DoorDash")

name: title_companies: CamelCase stop word rejected
spec_quote: · CamelCase ... — but not one of these words (any case): GenAI, DevOps, MLOps, DataOps, AIOps, FinTech, PowerBI, SaaS, IoT, eCommerce, JavaScript, TypeScript, GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube, ChatGPT, OpenAI

name: title_companies: hyphenated capitalised name
spec_quote: or · capitalised words joined by hyphens ("Georgia-Pacific", "Rolls-Royce") that contain no job word ("Full-Time" → nothing)

name: title_companies: all-caps first word with non-job second word

args.title: SAP iXp Intern - AI Product Management

spec_quote: · all capitals, at least 3 letters, not one of AI ML IT PM BI US USA HR UX UI QA GTM SWE MBA MS BS PHD IP RF ERP CRM GIS FP NLP LLM GEN IOT EV HVAC PRODUCT DATA INTERN INTERNSHIP SUMMER MARKETING FINANCE SALES NEW SR JR, AND the title has a second word that is not a job word: "SAP iXp Intern - AI Product Management" → "SAP"

name: title_companies: all-caps first word followed by job word
spec_quote: "SAP Business Analyst Intern" → nothing ("Business" is a job word)

name: title_companies: all-caps stop word rejected
spec_quote: · all capitals, at least 3 letters, not one of AI ML IT PM BI US USA HR UX UI QA GTM SWE MBA MS BS PHD IP RF ERP CRM GIS FP NLP LLM GEN IOT EV HVAC ...

name: title_companies: candidate identical to label dropped

args.title: Lumharquin - AGI - AI Power Systems Intern

spec_quote: Then drop a candidate that is the same company as the label (same name ignoring case, punctuation, spaces and suffixes such as Inc / LLC / Corp / Co: label "Lumharquin" drops "Lumharquin" ...)

name: title_companies: nothing found
spec_quote: (c) the title's first word ... when it is · CamelCase ... or · capitalised words joined by hyphens ... or · all capitals ... Nothing found → [].

name: title_companies: hyphenated form containing a job word
spec_quote: or · capitalised words joined by hyphens ("Georgia-Pacific", "Rolls-Royce") that contain no job word ("Full-Time" → nothing)
